included: Sourced tree, axe, location-access, depletion, inventory, banking, output, Forestry, and safety-boundary mechanics.
Separate deterministic, variable, RNG, and player-observed values for repeatable normalization.
A proposed woodcutting action with bounded tree variants and explicit stop/re-entry observations.
excluded: A universal cadence, route order, account-readiness inference, hourly guarantee, guaranteed RNG outcome, unattended-safety claim, or recommendation to train to level 99.
Community-world selection, social density, tick manipulation, or other strategy observations as guaranteed mechanics.

source_catalog.use: Woodcutting level and axe rules, four-tick rolls, tree depletion and regeneration, tree table, Forestry exclusions, group bonus exclusions, felling axes, log basket, and tree locations.
Concrete common-tree variants, level and experience comparison, location examples, and the guide's warning that rate figures are approximations rather than guarantees.
Axe level and Attack/equip boundaries and the distinction between carrying and wielding an axe.
Eligible tree types, event radius and timing, Forestry-kit/event eligibility, participation, event variability, and world-hopping caveat.
Official Forestry event interaction, rewards, Forestry kit items, two-handed/felling axe behavior, and Log Basket changes.
Willow level, experience, and tree-specific mechanics.
Woodcutting Guild redwood access, level, experience, section depletion and respawn, and low-attention characterization.
Player-grown redwood's four-slot, per-log depletion and respawn mechanics and Farming/room access boundary.
Woodcutting Guild 60 Woodcutting entry, invisible +7 boost, bank chest, tree inventory, and Forestry/group-bonus exclusions.
Fossil Island access boundary for island hardwood locations.

requirements.membership: Variant and location dependent; normal, oak, willow, maple, and yew have free-to-play entries, while several other locations or variants are members-only. [source: wiki-woodcutting-current]
requirements.woodcutting_level: Observed level must meet the selected tree: normal 1, oak 15, willow 30, teak 35, maple 45, yew 60, magic 75, or redwood 90. [source: wiki-woodcutting-current, wiki-tree-cutting-guide-current, wiki-willow-tree-current, wiki-redwood-tree-current]
requirements.axe: An axe is required. A higher-tier axe improves success chance; it may be wielded when the Attack requirement is met or carried in the inventory. [source: wiki-axes-current, wiki-woodcutting-current]
requirements.location_gates: Woodcutting Guild entry requires 60 Woodcutting and is boostable; Fossil Island hardwood access requires Bone Voyage; a player-grown Farming Guild redwood additionally requires the Farming Guild redwood/Farming state. [source: wiki-woodcutting-guild-current, wiki-bone-voyage-current, wiki-redwood-farming-current]

transport_options.claim: Transport is location-specific and may be by the player's available teleports, jewelry, minigame teleports, or ordinary travel.
No route order or fastest transport is normalized by this package.

inventory_inputs.item: optional Forestry kit/basket and optional log basket

bank_inputs.item: empty bank space for selected logs and incidental outputs

consumed_inputs.condition: only for a felling/two-handed axe setup; automatically consumed when applicable

capacity_constraints.claim: Without a log basket, free inventory slots and the carried or worn axe determine how many logs can be held before banking, dropping, or another player-selected handling action.
A log basket can add 28 log capacity, but the actual stop point remains dependent on the selected tree, incidental items, and player inventory state.

interaction_cadence.claim: Chopping rolls occur every four game ticks while the player is chopping.
A depleted ordinary tree requires a player interaction with another available tree or the respawned tree; the next interaction interval is variable by variant, location, and player observation.
Forestry events, when present and eligible, can require active event interactions and therefore add attention beyond the chopping roll.

session_mechanics.entry_condition: Player is logged in at an accessible selected tree variant with a usable axe and an inventory/banking plan. [source: wiki-axes-current, wiki-woodcutting-current]

duration_evidence.regeneration: For the standard timed tree mechanic, stopping before full depletion lets the tree regenerate according to its chopping time; exact player stop/restart behavior is not an AFK guarantee. [source: wiki-woodcutting-current]
duration_evidence.short_tree_variants: Normal and oak trees use their own short respawn/depletion behavior rather than the long redwood timer; use the selected tree page or player observation for the exact local cadence. [source: wiki-woodcutting-current, wiki-tree-cutting-guide-current]
duration_evidence.player_grown_redwood: Each of four choppable spaces has a 1/11 depletion chance per log and takes 200 ticks (120 seconds) to respawn when depleted. [source: wiki-redwood-farming-current]

session_end_events: Inventory or log-basket capacity is reached and no player-selected banking/drop handling occurs. [source: wiki-woodcutting-current]
The selected tree depletes and no available tree interaction is performed. [source: wiki-woodcutting-current]
The player logs out, leaves the location, loses the selected tool, or encounters a location-specific interruption. [source: wiki-woodcutting-current]

deterministic.description: When a chop succeeds, one log/resource item of the selected tree variant is received and its listed Woodcutting experience is awarded; this is conditional on a successful chop, not a session-total guarantee.
Base experience per received log is 25 normal, 37.5 oak, 67.5 willow, 85 teak, 100 maple, 175 yew, 250 magic, and 380 redwood.

variable.description: Total logs and total experience vary with Woodcutting level, axe, success rolls, tree depletion, tree availability, inventory handling, and session duration; no hourly value is guaranteed.
Bird nests and their contents are possible conditional outputs, with rates and types varying by tree and relevant equipment; redwoods have a distinct clue-nest boundary.
Eligible Forestry events can produce event experience, Anima-infused bark, leaves, and event-specific rewards; event occurrence and rewards are variable and participation-dependent.
With Forester's rations, a felling/two-handed axe gives 10% more Woodcutting experience and a 20% chance not to receive a log on a successful chop; ration supply and resulting logs are variable.

player_observed.description: Record selected variant, location, axe, Forestry equipment, start/end times, successful logs, total XP delta, bank/drop actions, event interruptions, and observed idle intervals; these are account/session observations and must not be synthesized from the plan.

damage_sources: Ordinary tree chopping has no generic damage step in the cited Woodcutting loop; monsters, Wilderness/PvP, random events, and location hazards remain location-specific and are not globally cleared by this package. [source: wiki-woodcutting-current, wiki-tree-cutting-guide-current]
logout_behavior: Logging out stops the player's active chopping/session state; no offline Woodcutting progression is asserted. [source: wiki-woodcutting-current]

Stopping before a standard tree fully depletes allows the tree's regeneration mechanic to apply; exact state after logout/re-entry must be observed for the selected location. [source: wiki-woodcutting-current]
safety_and_logout.safe_boundary: Only a player-confirmed location-specific boundary may be called safe. This package does not infer unattended safety, immunity from interruption, or survival from the absence of a generic damage step. [source: wiki-woodcutting-current]

mechanical_stop_conditions: Selected tree is depleted and no alternative tree is available or selected. [source: wiki-woodcutting-current]
Inventory/log-basket capacity or a player-selected bank/drop boundary is reached. [source: wiki-woodcutting-current]
A Forestry event appears and the player does not perform its required interaction; event-specific consequences are variable. [source: wiki-forestry-current, official-forestry-part-two-current]
mechanical_reentry_conditions: A selected tree or choppable section is available, the player is present, and a usable axe is carried or wielded. [source: wiki-axes-current, wiki-woodcutting-current]
For a depleted standard tree, its respawn has completed; for a player-grown redwood slot, its 200-tick respawn has completed. [source: wiki-woodcutting-current, wiki-redwood-farming-current]

For the Woodcutting Guild, the player still has observed access; for a Farming Guild redwood, the player-grown tree remains available. [source: wiki-woodcutting-guild-current, wiki-redwood-farming-current]
reset_or_cleanup_requirements: Bank, drop, or otherwise handle logs and incidental outputs before the next cycle when capacity is reached; the chosen handling is player-specific. [source: wiki-woodcutting-current]
Reacquire or re-equip an axe if it is no longer available, and reselect a tree if the prior tree or section has depleted. [source: wiki-axes-current, wiki-woodcutting-current]

Forestry event items, kit contents, and social-world choice require separate player-confirmed preparation; none is assumed by this package. [source: wiki-forestry-current, official-forestry-part-two-current]

conflicts_and_unknowns.detail: The general Woodcutting table supplies the normalized variant boundaries used here; individual tree pages can expose additional location, special-drop, or patch detail. Central integration should reconcile duplicate facts without assuming the guide's rate estimates.

Normal and oak interactions are not represented here as one universal AFK interval. Exact respawn, pathing, crowding, and available-tree behavior must be tied to a concrete location and player observation.

Forestry events are location- and eligibility-dependent, and the cited Wiki notes that world hopping should not create an abnormal event amount. This package does not select a community world, social density, or event strategy.
Four-tick rolls, success chance, event occurrence, bird nests, and event rewards are variable or RNG. They must not be converted into deterministic logs, XP, event counts, or hourly guarantees.

The package does not establish unattended safety or universal death impossibility. Wilderness/PvP, monsters, random events, travel, and local interruptions need a location-specific check before any operational use.

Crowding, world choice, tick manipulation, banking preference, and claimed attention intervals are player strategy observations, not sourced deterministic mechanics and are intentionally omitted from route scoring.
